اعتنيت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَيْتُ (iʕtanaytu) /iʕ.ta.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
# اِعْتَنَيْتَ (iʕtanayta) /iʕ.ta.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
# اِعْتَنَيْتِ (iʕtanayti) /iʕ.ta.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
